about: Bundled sources: every entry appears in Browse right after install, in its category, and opens in the in-app browser.
People can edit, hide, remove, reorder and favourite them in Browse › Sources. Onboarding turns categories on.
Fields: id (unique; never reuse one), name, url (https), category (manga | manhwa | manhua | webtoons | comics | novels),
note (one short line), native (true only for sites with a dedicated connection in the app), style (optional:
manga | manhwa | manhua | webtoon | comic). Everything else on a site works through the generic browser and reader.
